description: REAL, in-use worker. Claude Code runs an isolated writer lane inside its own git worktree, touches only files inside its declared file lease, commits once, pushes its own branch, and opens a draft PR requesting a Copilot review. It never merges (the Terminal-0 sheriff merges) and never activates application runtime or a forbidden provider. This descriptor documents the workflow already exercised by the foundergate/* isolated-writer lanes (H1-H7).

input_contract.mission: A single scoped mission statement handed to the lane as its task prompt (director/orchestrator message; never treated as founder consent).
input_contract.branch: foundergate/<lane-slug> assigned by the orchestrator; the lane stays on it and never switches.
hard_exclusions: no git push to a shared/protected branch beyond the lane's own
no application runtime activation or marker flip

expected_outputs.commit_message_convention: proof(...) or feat(...) subject line ending with the Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer

pr_handoff.body_convention: PR body ends with the '🤖 Generated with Claude Code' trailer; a GATE REPORT block is included when a true founder gate appears.

integration_evidence: REAL: exercised by the foundergate/* isolated-writer lanes H1-H6 (draft PRs #193, #203, and the H1-H6 harness series).
REAL: workflow matches the isolated-writer contract in docs/contracts/AGENT_CONSTITUTION.md (file-lease + no-self-merge).
